Name: Casper And The Box - Custom NPC
Author: sapphicsaph
Description:
[left]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/W3oHGO1.png[/img]﻿
Meet Casper! A vagabond sauntering about Pelican Town, making friends, making enemies, and, most notably: making a mess! Casper is genderfluid, preferring 'he' most of the time, 'they' always, and 'she' on occasion. They have a lot of habits that make them stand out. Try loud, controversial, forgetful, questionably dressed and probably smelly, but really very lovable.[/left]
Full seasonal portraits and sprites included, courtesy of the ridiculously talented PlatinumCats, Fellowclown and AirynS. Casper is fully romanceable, with a very dynamic schedule making room for lots and lots of compatibility with expansions, revamped maps, and other custom NPCs. 

This mod is meant to be fun and feel-good, there are no mature themes to be worried about outside of their absurd behavior!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oqf5Czp.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Seasonal portraits and sprites.
[*]1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 14 heart events with Conversation Topics.
[*]Daily dialogue for every season, weekday and heart level.
[*]A custom interior map that houses Casper.
[*]Dynamic schedules in every season.
[*]Compatibility schedules and dialogues for mod-added locations.
[*]Gift tastes for vanilla and modded items.
[*]A couple quests and a couple pieces of mail.
[*]Festival and movie theater attendance.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/6ecrL9o.png[/img]
[b]THE FUTURE[/b] of Casper & The Box:

[/list]
